days.title: Northern Peaks and Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pyhäkerö
stops.detail: Popular day hikes include, for example, the Pyhäkerö day tour, the Taivaskero circular trail, the Pirunkurun ponnistus, the Varkaankuru path, the Kesänkijärvi circular trail, and the Tuomikuru circular trail.

stops.name: Lumikero
stops.detail: Other high peaks are, for example, Pyhäkero, Lumikero, Laukukero, and Palkaskero.

stops.name: Taivaskero
stops.detail: The highest point in the national park is Taivaskero of Pallastunturi at 809 meters above sea level.

stops.name: Pallasjärvi
stops.detail: The largest lake in the park is Lake Pallasjärvi, which lies southeast of the Pallastunturi Visitor Centre.

stops.name: Sammaltunturi

stops.name: Naturzentrum Pallastunturi
stops.detail: In Pallas-Yllästunturi National Park, there are three visitor centres: The Yllästunturi Visitor Centre Kellokas, the Pallastunturi Visitor Centre, and the Tunturi-Lappi Visitor Centre in Heta.
